fao_data_dir(): 下载的FAO数据的保存目录

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/fao_data_dir.Rmd
fao_data_dir.Rmd

英文原页：fao_data_dir()

说明

返回download_fao_data()和download_fishbase_data()保存数据、所有函数查找数据的目录：优先使用fao_settings(data_dir = ...)设置的文件夹，其次是环境变量FAOFISHINGREPORT_DATA_DIR，否则为R的用户数据文件夹（tools::R_user_dir("faofishingreport", "data")）。

English

Returns the directory where download_fao_data() and download_fishbase_data() save data and where all functions look for it: the folder set with fao_settings(data_dir = ...), else the environment variable FAOFISHINGREPORT_DATA_DIR, else the user data folder of R (tools::R_user_dir("faofishingreport", "data")).

用法 

fao_data_dir()

返回值

一个字符串，即该目录的路径。

English

A character string with the directory path.

详细说明

如果要在每个R会话中都使用同一个文件夹，例如由多台电脑或一个团队共享的云端文件夹，可以在用户主目录的.Renviron文件（file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".Renviron")）中加一行FAOFISHINGREPORT_DATA_DIR=<文件夹>，然后重启R。

English

To use the same folder in every R session, e.g. a cloud folder shared by several computers or a team, add a line FAOFISHINGREPORT_DATA_DIR=<folder> to the .Renviron file in your home folder (file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".Renviron")) and restart R.

另请参阅

Other FAO data: check_fao_update(), download_fao_data(), fao_data_info(), load_fao_data()

示例 

fao_data_dir()
fao_settings(data_dir = "D:/shared/fao_data")   # e.g. a folder shared by a team
